part_1_rate_correction.implementation: One policy action is held for two 0.05 s physics steps, producing the contracted 0.1 s / 10 Hz control interval.

exact_prior_shaping.classification: This is already the policy-invariant discounted potential-based form. It is neither raw k*distance proximity reward nor the undiscounted k*(distance_previous-distance_next) form.
exact_prior_shaping.stationary_transition: At unchanged distance d it emits (1-gamma)*k*d = 0.05*d immediate shaping reward. Under the matching discounted objective the terms telescope; the concern diagnosed here is optimization/value scale, not conversion from a non-potential reward.

scale_derivation.interpretation_caveat: The 2845.42 figure is an undiscounted telemetry sum, whereas PPO optimizes gamma-discounted return. It is used because the requested scale criterion explicitly compares accumulated shaping telemetry with the 100-point terminal bonus.

execution_plan_after_approval.phase_1: Retrain final-leg isolation at 10 Hz, maximum 1.5M steps, evaluating every 250k steps.
execution_plan_after_approval.convergence: At least 90% success at two consecutive checkpoints on seeds 30000-30049.
execution_plan_after_approval.failure: Stop and report without a fifth revision.
execution_plan_after_approval.success: Continue from the converged checkpoint into the existing 3M full-episode fine-tuning and Gate 3 protocol.
